lines.text: Welcome to the floor. Real messages, fake consequences. Try not to enjoy that too much.
Here comes the crew. They brought opinions. You brought judgment. Let's see who's right.
Floor and crew together. Bold. Nothing says confidence like an audience for your mistakes.
lines.use: when: floor and crew both present at open

lines.text: That one had a price tag. You saw the cost and called anyway. No shame.
lines.use: when: expensive call, cost shown to player

lines.text: Expensive call. You read the cost like a menu and ordered anyway. Respectable appetite.
lines.use: when: expensive call, player accepted the price

lines.text: You paid full price for that judgment. The receipt is honest, and so were you.
lines.use: when: expensive call, full cost borne

lines.text: Ouch. That call cost real coin, and you made it with your eyes wide open.
lines.use: when: expensive call, player knew the cost

lines.text: An expensive lesson, delivered on schedule. You'll remember this one. That's the whole point.
Your gut got there first, and it was right. Don't let it go to your head.
Instinct, and it landed. I'd say I'm impressed, but you'd only get smug about it.
lines.use: when: instinct call proved right, player is ahead

lines.text: Called it on feel, and the feel was good. Quietly excellent. On to the next.
lines.use: when: instinct call proved right, mid-run

lines.text: You knew before you knew why. One small smile is permitted. Then back to work.
lines.use: when: instinct call proved right on a hard one

lines.text: You shrank the room again, and it worked again. I believe this is called a habit.
There it is again: one question, asked early, doing all the work. Keep that trick.
lines.use: when: player asked the one clarifying question again

lines.text: You chose shipping over polish again. Rough, fast, and out the door. I approve quietly.
lines.use: when: player shipped over polished again

lines.text: You named the gap instead of guessing. Good. That is always the right instinct here.
lines.use: when: player named the gap instead of guessing

lines.text: That's the session. You get one door to open before you go. Choose it well.
lines.use: when: session wraps, handing the player their one door

lines.text: You got better at this today. Go easy on yourself tonight. I'm serious.
